body.x: The world's largest and most influentialtechnology event CES 2020 is three weeks ahead. At CES, you can explore allareas of the global technology market, including AI, 5G, automotive, AR/VR, androbots. With 61% of global brands selected by Fortune participating in CES2020, CES is expected to expand its existing technology footprint and solidifythe message that all companies in the current era are technology companies.Hosted and hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2020 willbe held in Las Vegas, USA from January 7-10, 2020.

Karen Chupka, senior vice president of CTA, said, “With technology in almost every major industry driving business innovation, CES 2020 will be the place where companies from around the world come together to illuminate the latest technological innovations with no boundaries between sectors and regions. "In particular, this CES showcases the travel and tourism areas for the first time, as well as smart city and resilience exhibits for a different experience."

Starting as a technology exhibition, CES has evolved into a worldwide event that now brings together more than 170,000 attendees, more than 4,500 exhibitors and 1,100 industry leaders. In Asia this year, major companies like Samsung Electronics, LG Electronics, Doosan, SK Telecom, Toyota, Huawei, Lenovo and Nikon will participate.
